entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shido's the guy who set you up!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What kind of fate brought you two back[n]together?
It's definitely him.
I want to know myself.
Is it just coincidence?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Talk about a destined connection...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shido was involved in the cognitive[n]research too, right? This can't be[n]dismissed as just a coincidence...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: God... What the hell's going on here?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Shido was already a politician then, yet[n]he sued a student and ruined his future?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He must've pulled some strings so that[n]his name wouldn't be mentioned...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Furthermore, he also would've had to[n]force that woman into making a false[n]statement.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He would do anything. We're talking[n]about a man who ordered a hit inside[n]the police station.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: He can't sit still until he crushes whoever[n]opposes him, no matter how trivial. He's[n]always been that way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What a piece of shit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Children are the future," my ass! What[n]he's sayin' and doin' are completely[n]different!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But now that we found out who did it,[n]can't something be done about[n][fName]'s record!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Once the courts have made a judgment,[n]overturning that decision will be difficult.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It'd barely be possible even if proof of[n]innocence is presented and Shido admits[n]to his crimes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: At any rate, we need to trigger a change[n]of heart in him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Be that as it may, Shido's outer[n]appearance and his true face are[n]wholly different.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's beyond hypocritical. It's as if he's an[n]entirely different person.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He speaks about the good of the country...[n]It makes me wonder what really is on his[n]mind.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That man's full of ambition to rise in[n]the world.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: He only thinks of the weak as stepping[n]stools for his success.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He treats himself as an elite man while[n]looking down on others... That's the worst.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I assume the keyword for what he believes[n]the Diet Building is will be despicable too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It must be something self-centered and[n]completely different from politics.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Someone like him needs to be punished[n]as soon as possible!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's head to the Diet Building again right[n]after school tomorrow. I feel we'll get it[n]this time!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Stewing over it won't get anywhere.[n]We have to do this...
